_comment: Example multi-fact (supporting-fact) citations showing the children/c compact key format. Each scenario demonstrates a different real-world pattern where facts are semantically coupled.

scenarios.name: Legal: Court order directive with date and scope (cross-page)
scenarios.description: The directive 'preserve and segregate' is the primary fact. The scope ('all output log data') and the date ('May 13, 2025') are supporting facts — the date is on a different page (signature block).
scenarios.llm_output:
OpenAI was directed to **preserve and segregate all output log data** [1], per the court order dated May 13, 2025.

<<<CITATION_DATA>>>
{"courtorder-abc123": [{"n": 1, "k": "preserve and segregate", "f": "Accordingly, OpenAI is NOW DIRECTED to preserve and segregate all output log data that would otherwise be deleted on a going forward basis until further order of the Court", "p": "page_number_2_index_1", "l": [12, 13, 14], "r": "Court's directive to OpenAI regarding log preservation", "c": [{"k": "output log data", "f": "preserve and segregate all output log data that would otherwise be deleted", "p": "page_number_2_index_1", "l": [12, 13]}, {"k": "May 13, 2025", "f": "Dated: May 13, 2025\nNew York, New York\nUnited States Magistrate Judge", "p": "page_number_5_index_4", "l": [38, 39, 40], "r": "Filing date from signature block on final page"}]}]}
<<<END_CITATION_DATA>>>

scenarios.name: Financial: Revenue claim with amount, growth, and period (same page)
scenarios.description: The growth rate '45% year-over-year' is the primary fact. The dollar amount ('$2.3 billion') and the period ('Q4 2024') are supporting facts, all on the same page of the earnings report.
scenarios.llm_output:
Acme Corp reported **45% year-over-year revenue growth** [1] in its latest quarterly filing.

<<<CITATION_DATA>>>
{"earnings-10k-xyz": [{"n": 1, "k": "45% year-over-year", "f": "Total revenue for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 was $2.3 billion, representing 45% year-over-year growth compared to $1.59 billion in Q4 2023.", "p": "page_number_12_index_11", "l": [8, 9], "r": "Revenue growth percentage from earnings summary", "c": [{"k": "$2.3 billion", "f": "Total revenue for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 was $2.3 billion", "p": "page_number_12_index_11", "l": [8]}, {"k": "Q4 2024", "f": "for the quarter ended December 31, 2024", "p": "page_number_12_index_11", "l": [8]}]}]}
<<<END_CITATION_DATA>>>

scenarios.name: Cross-document: Contract clause referencing an exhibit
scenarios.description: The indemnification obligation is the primary fact from the main contract. The liability cap ('$5 million') is a supporting fact from a different document (Exhibit B). Note the child uses a different attachment_id.
scenarios.llm_output:
The vendor's **indemnification obligation** [1] is subject to a contractual liability cap.

<<<CITATION_DATA>>>
{"contract-main-001": [{"n": 1, "k": "indemnification obligation", "f": "Vendor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Client from any third-party claims arising from Vendor's breach of this Agreement, subject to the limitations set forth in Exhibit B.", "p": "page_number_8_index_7", "l": [15, 16, 17], "r": "Core indemnification clause in main agreement", "c": [{"k": "$5 million", "f": "The aggregate liability of Vendor under Section 8 (Indemnification) shall not exceed $5,000,000 (Five Million US Dollars).", "a": "exhibit-b-002", "p": "page_number_2_index_1", "l": [4, 5], "r": "Liability cap from Exhibit B, a separate attachment"}]}]}
<<<END_CITATION_DATA>>>

scenarios.name: Medical: Drug dosage with frequency and duration
scenarios.description: The antibiotic recommendation is the primary fact. The specific dosage ('500 mg'), frequency ('tid'), and duration ('8 days') are supporting facts that a clinician must verify independently.
scenarios.llm_output:
The report recommends adjunctive **Amoxicillin therapy** [1] based on the patient's bacterial profile.

<<<CITATION_DATA>>>
{"lab-report-dental": [{"n": 1, "k": "Amoxicillin therapy", "f": "Published guidelines suggest the following as a possible adjunct to treatment: Amoxicillin 500 mg tid 8 days and Metronidazole 500 mg bid 8 days.", "p": "page_number_2_index_1", "l": [15, 16], "r": "Antibiotic recommendation from lab report", "c": [{"k": "500 mg", "f": "Amoxicillin 500 mg tid 8 days", "p": "page_number_2_index_1", "l": [15]}, {"k": "tid 8 days", "f": "Amoxicillin 500 mg tid 8 days", "p": "page_number_2_index_1", "l": [15], "r": "Dosing frequency and treatment duration"}]}]}
<<<END_CITATION_DATA>>>

scenarios.name: URL: News article with statistic and attribution
scenarios.description: A URL citation where the primary fact is a statistic and the supporting fact is the attribution/source of that statistic, from a different section of the same article.
scenarios.llm_output:
Global AI spending is projected to reach **$200 billion by 2025** [1], according to recent industry analysis.

<<<CITATION_DATA>>>
[{"n": 1, "type": "url", "url": "https://example.com/ai-spending-forecast", "domain": "example.com", "title": "AI Spending Forecast 2025", "k": "$200 billion", "f": "Worldwide spending on artificial intelligence is forecast to reach $200 billion in 2025, up from $154 billion in 2024.", "l": [12], "r": "Headline spending projection figure", "c": [{"k": "by 2025", "f": "is forecast to reach $200 billion in 2025, up from $154 billion in 2024", "l": [12]}, {"k": "IDC", "f": "according to the International Data Corporation (IDC) Worldwide AI Spending Guide published in March 2025", "l": [45], "r": "Attribution — the statistic comes from a specific IDC report"}]}]
